reference.method: Median strongest-50ms RMS of the live game's six existing melee/bow cues, including the game master gain. Match toward that digital output at the board's 55% reference volume. Other volume settings scale normally. Current game cues reproduce their original relative gains; authored quiet edits retain zero makeup gain.

method: Constant gain per decoded take/full session. Target strongest 50ms RMS subject to sample-peak ceiling; no compressor, no true-peak or perceptual loudness guarantee. Authored quiet edits keep zero gain; archived game samples retain their relative game gain at the board reference volume.
